outcome: Impact of medical assessment on cesarean rate
cohort: Women who had a planned cesarean section at term, were nulliparous or primiparous, and had a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation or a twin pregnancy with twin 1 in cephalic presentation within the Auvergne perinatal health network in France
finding: About one-third of planned cesarean sections were deemed inappropriate based on French guidelines, with maternal and provider preferences contributing significantly.
